sql: SELECT "weekly_weather"."station_id" AS k, (CAST("weekly_weather"."low_temperature" AS REAL) / "weekly_weather"."high_temperature") AS m1 FROM "weekly_weather" WHERE (CAST("weekly_weather"."low_temperature" AS REAL) / "weekly_weather"."high_temperature") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: weekly_weather.daily low temperature relative to daily high temperature
why: daily low temperature / daily high temperature: a ratio of two quantities in celsius
rank weekly_weather rows by daily low temperature relative to daily high temperature

sql: SELECT "weekly_weather"."station_id" AS k, ("weekly_weather"."high_temperature" - "weekly_weather"."low_temperature") AS m1 FROM "weekly_weather" WHERE ("weekly_weather"."high_temperature" - "weekly_weather"."low_temperature") IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m1 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: weekly_weather.daily high temperature minus daily low temperature
why: daily high temperature - daily low temperature: both in celsius and of the same kind (stocks) on the same one station's weather forecast for a day of week
rank weekly_weather rows by daily high temperature minus daily low temperature
